description: POST /ta/indicators with a 50-close linear ramp (10.0+i*0.5, period=14) returns 200 JSON with RSI populated (length >= 36), MACD populated, Bollinger Bands populated. Pure-compute path: closes provided directly in the request body — zero DB credentials, zero SQLite access. httptest.NewServer routes the request through the full DDD stack (interface/http → application → pkg/module).
